video.title: AI欧腐《花花公子怀孕了/The Playboy Got Knocked Up》S2
video.desc:
Levi is forced to flee to Italy while carrying Cillian's child,the price of Margaret Ashford's cold ultimatum. Back in New York, Cillan is imprisoned and pushed into a fake engagement, but he never stops searching. In a quiet southern town, Levi meets Ric,a tender yet dangerous mafia heir willing to accept him and his baby,As lies unravel, love grows real-and when the truth breaks, will they still have time to say I love you?
Levi怀着Cillian的孩子，被Margaret Ashford冷酷逼迫，只能逃往意大利。
而在纽约，Cillian被囚禁，还被迫卷入一场虚假的订婚。可他从未停止寻找Levi。
在意大利南部一座安静的小镇上，Levi遇见了Ric——一位温柔却危险的黑手党继承人。他愿意接纳Levi，也愿意接纳他腹中的孩子。
随着谎言层层揭开，爱意也逐渐变得真实。可当真相终于爆发时，他们是否还来得及亲口说出那句：“我爱你。”
